notes.notes: Fixes a soft lock in presentation mode when more than 5 phrases were used in the graph view.

notes.title: 1.0.3 Released
notes.notes: Updates underlying libraries for performance and security improvements.

notes.title: 1.0.1 Released
notes.notes: The 1.0.1 beta is now live. See the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/944730/view/2999939903850076894]beta post[/url] for the full change set.

notes.title: 1.0.1 Beta
notes.notes:
[h3]General Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Updated Unity and libraries.
[/list]

[h3]Presentation Mode[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added the team name and color to the presentation screen on word prompts.
[*] Fixed multiple issues which could cause scores to be incorrectly calculated in presentation mode.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34170604/87d356031ef9f7de9695ee2f91359dd07accefd9.png[/img]

[h3]How to Use the Beta[/h3]
[olist]
[*] Open the Properties window for Trends in Steam.
[*] Click the Betas tab.
[*] Choose the 1.0.1 version.
[/olist]

You can revert to any previous version or the currently live version in the same way.
